test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a Tibeto-Burmese language?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripuri.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tripuri:-**

 
 
• It is a **Tibeto-Burmese language **spoken in the Indian state of** Tripura and parts of Bangladesh.**
 
 
 
• **Tibeto-Burmese languages **are a branch of the **Sino-Tibetan language family** and are spoken in parts of **China, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Bhutan, and Bangladesh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Odia:-

 
 
• It​ is also known as Oriya, is an Indo-Aryan language spoken in the Indian state of Odisha.
 
 
 
• Assamese:-
 
 
• It is also an Indo-Aryan language spoken in the Indian state of Assam and parts of Bangladesh.
 
 
 
• Tulu:-
 
 
• It​ is a Dravidian language spoken in the Indian state of Karnataka and parts of Kerala.
